en.t: Shinsuke had never drunk breast milk.

units.source_text: 母亲原本身体就比较虚弱，生下他这个命根子后，更是一点奶都没有。

en.t: His mother had always been rather frail, and after giving birth to him, her precious only child, she had no milk at all.

units.source_text: 不但这样，因为家里穷，也请不起奶妈。

en.t: Not only that, but because the family was poor, they could not afford to hire a wet nurse either.

units.source_text: 因此，他从出生之后，就是一直靠着喝牛奶长大的。

en.t: So from the time he was born, he grew up entirely on cow's milk.

units.source_text: 对于那个时候的信辅来说，这真是一个令人懊恼的命运。

en.t: For Shinsuke at that time, this was truly a vexing fate.

units.source_text: 他轻视每天早上送到厨房的牛奶瓶，羡慕那些就算什么都不懂却了解怎么喝母乳的朋友。

en.t: He looked down on the milk bottles delivered to the kitchen every morning, and envied his friends who, though they understood nothing else, knew how to drink breast milk.

units.source_text: 他上小学的时候，不知道是信念还是什么其他日子，年轻的婶婶来到他家，据说是涨奶涨的很痛苦。

en.t: When he was in elementary school, on some day whose occasion he did not know, his young aunt came to his house, apparently suffering badly because her breasts were swollen with milk.

units.source_text: 婶婶想把奶水挤在一个黄铜的漱口杯里，但是却无论如何也挤不出来。

en.t: His aunt tried to express the milk into a brass rinsing cup, but no matter what she did, none would come out.

units.source_text: 婶婶皱着眉头，半开玩笑的跟他说：“小新帮婶婶把奶水吸出来吧！”

en.t: Frowning, his aunt said to him half in jest, "Little Shin, help your aunt suck the milk out!"

units.source_text: 但是喝牛奶长大的他，根本不知道怎么吸母乳。

en.t: But having grown up on cow's milk, he had no idea at all how to suck breast milk.

units.source_text: 后来，婶婶找到邻居木匠家的女儿，帮忙吸食婶婶涨的发硬的乳房。

en.t: Later, his aunt found the daughter from the neighboring carpenter's family and had her help suck at the breasts that had swollen hard with milk.

units.source_text: 婶婶的乳房鼓得像半个圆球，上面满是青色静脉。

en.t: His aunt's breasts bulged like half-spheres, covered with bluish veins.

units.source_text: 信辅生来腼腆，即使他知道怎么吸奶，他也一定不愿意去吸食婶婶的奶水。

en.t: Shinsuke was shy by nature, and even if he had known how to suck milk, he certainly would not have wanted to suck his aunt's milk.

units.source_text: 虽然这样，他仍然讨厌邻居木匠家的女儿。

en.t: Even so, he still hated the daughter from the neighboring carpenter's family.

units.source_text: 同时，他也讨厌让邻居木匠家的女儿吸奶的深深。

en.t: At the same time, he also hated the aunt who had let the neighboring carpenter's daughter suck her milk.

units.source_text: 这样小事在信辅的心中留下了很是阴郁的嫉妒心理。

en.t: This small incident left a very gloomy jealousy in Shinsuke's heart.

units.source_text: 但是，除了这件事之外，可能那时候他的Vita sexualis（直接翻译的意思是性欲的生活）已经蠢蠢欲动了……

en.t: But apart from this incident, perhaps by then his Vita sexualis, literally meaning the life of sexual desire, had already begun to stir...
